title: DatasetSplitSpec
description:
Per-dataset split assignment specification for source datasets that do not provide their own train/val/test splits. Defines how corpus_assigned split_type values are determined reproducibly and documents any pre-planned OOD designations.

One spec per source dataset that requires corpus-assigned splits. Stored in docs/schema/split_specs/{dataset}.json. Source-native datasets (DocLayNet, RVL-CDIP, etc.) do not need a spec — their splits are applied directly.

The val and test assignments computed from this spec are immutable once applied. The seed and stratify_by fields must be preserved exactly to reproduce assignments if a dataset is re-ingested.

dataset.description: Canonical dataset name from DATASET_NAMING_STANDARD.md. Must match source_dataset in corpus manifest records.

split_source.description: Always 'corpus_assigned' for this schema. Source-native datasets do not require a spec.

spec_version.description: Semantic version of this spec. Increment the minor version when changing ratios or stratification (requires re-ingestion of the dataset). Increment the patch version for documentation-only changes.

strategy.description:
Split assignment strategy.

'stratified': proportional sampling by stratify_by L2 fields. Ensures each split contains representative coverage across key diversity dimensions (e.g., shadow_severity bucket, capture_method). Preferred for datasets where label distribution is known.

'random': purely random assignment by ratio. Use when L2 fields are not yet populated at spec creation time, or when the dataset is known to be internally homogeneous.

stratify_by.description: L2 EnrichmentData field paths to stratify splits by. Only applies when strategy = 'stratified'. Dot-notation path from the data object (e.g., 'capture_method.method', 'physical_degradation.shadow_type'). null or empty when strategy = 'random'.

ingest_sample_size.description: How many images to ingest from this source dataset into the corpus (active + reserved combined). For large datasets, this is a deliberate supersample: ingest more than needed for initial training to build a reserve buffer for future OOD expansion and training augmentation without requiring re-ingestion.

total.description: Total number of images to ingest (active + reserved). For datasets smaller than this value, all images are ingested.

sampling_strategy.description: 'all': ingest every image in the dataset. 'stratified_sample': stratified by stratify_by fields. 'random_sample': random subset. 'head_of_dataset': first N images (useful for reproducibility with ordered datasets like RVL-CDIP).

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of the sample size choice. Document why this size was chosen and what reserve buffer it provides.
examples: sd7k has 7,239 total images. Ingest all — dataset is small enough that full ingestion is practical. Provides ~1,400 reserved images (20%) as OOD/expansion buffer after initial 5,800 active assignment.

RVL-CDIP has 400K total images. Ingest 80K (20%): 50K active train + 20K reserved buffer + 10K val/test. Full ingestion would require 50GB+ of corpus manifest storage with minimal incremental value for initial training run.

ratios.description: Target proportion of INGESTED samples for each split. active_train + active_val + active_test + reserved must equal 1.0. The reserved allocation is the buffer pool — images ingested but not activated. Remainder after active splits = reserved.

active_train.description: Proportion of ingested samples assigned to active train.

active_val.description: Proportion of ingested samples assigned to active val. Immutable once assigned.

active_test.description: Proportion of ingested samples assigned to active test. Immutable once assigned.

reserved.description: Proportion of ingested samples held as reserved buffer. Computed as 1.0 - (active_train + active_val + active_test) if not specified explicitly. These images are never seen by any model until deliberately activated.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible split assignment and sampling. Must be preserved exactly. Changing the seed requires a new spec_version and re-ingestion. Default: 42.

ood_predesignations.description: Pre-planned OOD designations to apply at corpus construction time. These images are drawn from the reserved pool (preferred) or from the active train pool (fallback). Pre-designated OOD records have ood_source = 'predesignated' and ood_predesignated = true — no model ever trains on them, providing a clean evaluation boundary.

category.description: OOD scenario category. Must match ood_category values in corpus manifest records.

target_count.description: Target number of images to pre-designate as OOD from this dataset.

source_pool.description: 'reserved_first': draw from reserved pool; if insufficient, draw from active train (preferred default — maximizes clean OOD boundaries). 'train_only': force draw from active train (use when reserved pool does not contain the required characteristics). 'reserved_only': only draw from reserved; fail if pool is insufficient.

selection_criteria.description: Human-readable description of which images qualify for this OOD category.
examples: sd7k clean reference images where the paired shadow image has shadow_type = 'book_gutter'. These are the only clean-reference analogs to book-gutter shadow examples in the dataset.
MIDV500 images captured with camera at >30 degree angle (high perspective distortion)

selection_filter.description: Machine-readable L2 field filters used to identify OOD candidates. Key = dot-notation L2 field path, value = required value or array of accepted values. null if selection requires manual curation rather than filter.

actual_count.description: Actual number designated. null until corpus construction executes this predesignation.

designated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when OOD designation was executed. null until executed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this spec was created.

created_by.description: Author or script that created this spec.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this spec was applied to produce corpus manifest records. null until corpus construction runs. Once applied, val and test assignments derived from this spec are immutable.

applied_by.description: Script version that applied this spec during corpus construction. null until applied.

val_immutable_since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when val assignments from this spec were locked. Equal to applied_at. Once set, val assignments for this dataset cannot change even if the spec is revised.

test_immutable_since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when test assignments from this spec were locked. Equal to applied_at. Once set, test assignments for this dataset cannot change even if the spec is revised.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about split design decisions for this dataset. Document domain-specific considerations, known biases, or deviations from the default strategy.
